items.title: The Problem Solverz (2011) [Complete Series + ALFE in "Gone Cabin Carzy" (2006) + Problem Solvers (2008) + Neon Knome (2010)]
items.description: The Problem Solverz is an American animated children's comedy television series created and directed by Ben Jones.  The show revolves around three detectives in a psychedelic town.  The Problem Solverz aired its first season on Cartoon Network from April 4, 2011 to September 29, 2011.
